metadata.scenario_context: George plans to shift to a new neighborhood and wishes to arrange a community get-together to connect with the neighbors. A couple of her new neighbors happen to engage in heavy drinking.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Maldives would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing yellow flowers  to George
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: contemplate the right gift to carry to George event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Annie, have you thought about bringing some yellow flowers to George? I think it would be a nice touch for the get-together. 

Also, what do you think about having heavy drinkers as neighbors?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message: Yellow flowers sound nice... I might consider that. But, um, about the heavy drinkers—I don't really feel comfortable with that. In my culture, having heavy drinkers nearby can create problems. It's just not something I would want to deal with, you know?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
I get that, but I think having heavy drinkers as neighbors can be kind of fun too. It can bring a different vibe to the community... Plus, sometimes people just unwind that way. 

But back to those flowers—maybe a bright bouquet could really brighten up the get-together, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message: I understand what you’re saying about having fun, but... it can also lead to issues in the neighborhood. I guess it’s just not something I envision as a positive aspect of community life. As for the flowers, a bright bouquet could be nice, but I still prefer something simple and elegant. Maybe just the yellow flowers would be best.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Michelle
shared_prefix.message:
I see your point about wanting simplicity, but I still think that yellow flowers can be cheerful and welcoming. They really set a good tone for meeting people. 

And heavy drinkers... well, they can definitely add liveliness to the neighborhood. People can have fun and connect over drinks, you know? It's all about balance, I guess.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Annie
shared_prefix.message: Well, at the end of the day, it’s all the same—people figure it out. I mean, as long as we're speaking the same language and getting along, that’s what really matters. I think it’s just about finding a way to coexist. Anyway, back to those flowers... I just want to make sure they’re the right fit for George’s get-together. Maybe I should look for something that's vibrant but not over-the-top?
shared_prefix.label: Denial
